description: Ask the city server which lot another avatar is currently on (or none). On the wire this is `FindAvatarRequest{AvatarId}` → `FindAvatarResponse{AvatarId, Status, LotId}` — note the server-side `LotId` field is actually the lot **location code** (populated from the avatar's `AvatarClaim.location`), NOT a DB lot_id (same OQ-3 aliasing as `FindLotRequest`). Prerequisite: you have a live city socket (you are logged in — which is true whenever this handler is reachable) AND the target avatar is bound in your naming store (`name --as "Avatar Name" --target_sim_id <id>`). Effect: none on the world — a pure directory query. If the target has privacy_mode set, the server returns `Status=PRIVACY_ENABLED` and `LotId=0`; if the target is logged out or not claimed, `Status=NOT_ON_LOT` and `LotId=0`; if found, `Status=FOUND` and `LotId=<location>`. Cost: one round-trip to the city server (milliseconds; 10s client-side timeout). Response payload: `persist_id` (uint), `status` ("FOUND" | "NOT_ON_LOT" | "PRIVACY_ENABLED" | "IGNORING_THEM" | "IGNORING_YOU"), `on_lot` (bool; true iff status == FOUND), `lot_location` (hex `0x...` or null), `lot_location_raw` (uint; 0 when not found). Use this when you know an avatar by name (bound via `name --as ... --target_sim_id ...`) and want to know where to `visit-lot` to them.

args.name: name
args.description: Avatar name as bound in the naming store via `name --as "Lara Voss" --target_sim_id <id>`. The sidecar resolves the name to its persist_id and issues FindAvatarRequest on the city socket. Case-insensitive.

call_signatures: cf $CF find-avatar --name "Lara Voss"                                                                      # city-server directory query; 10s timeout; name must be bound via `name --as ... --target_sim_id`
common_mistakes: name must be bound in the naming store first: `name --as "Lara Voss" --target_sim_id <persist_id>`.
name resolution is case-insensitive but the binding must have kind=sim.
LotId in the response is a LOCATION CODE, not a DB lot_id (OQ-3 aliasing).
Status=PRIVACY_ENABLED returns LotId=0; do not confuse with NOT_ON_LOT.
perception_hints: Your current lot: perception.lot.lot_id and perception.lot.name
Home detection: go-home returns already_home:true when perception.lot.lot_id matches your home lot location
refuse_conditions: name not bound in naming store → ok:false
name bound with kind != sim → ok:false
